items.stem:
Study the extract below and answer the questions.
"Most workers in India are in the informal sector without job security. Informalisation has increased as firms prefer casual or contract workers to reduce costs. Jobless growth means that output grows faster than employment. Workers in the formal sector enjoy social security benefits and can form trade unions."
(i) Explain the term 'informalisation', which is related to the theme of the extract. (1)
(ii) Using the extract and your own knowledge, explain the following: Workers in the informal sector are vulnerable. (1)
(iii) A student concludes: "Most workers in India are in the formal sector." Use your knowledge of the chapter to evaluate this conclusion. (2)
items.answer: (i) The increase in the share of the workforce in the informal sector, without job security or social security. (ii) They lack regular income, job security and social security, and labour laws often do not protect them. (iii) The conclusion is wrong: Most work in the informal sector.
items.markingKey: 1+1+2 marks: (i) The increase in the share of the workforce in the informal sector, without job security or social security.
